title: A SIGTERM stop of a serving owner takes 0 to 1 s after its drain finishes. The maintenance worker (host/native/owner.lisp fnn-owner-start-maintenance) sleeps a fixed (sleep 1) between ticks, and the stop joins it. Measured on hbox, set 6107ceb56, developer image, fresh store: 'stopping: drained after 0 ms' came at +1 ms and the exit at +528 ms; Node.stop measured 1.07 s three times out of three, against init 0.14 s and start 0.13 s. Every native pays this on every stop and restart (405 tests at batch 6, most stopping at least once), and so does an operator stop. Fix: the worker waits on the owner's commit signal (fnn-owner-signal-commit, which the stop raises), bounded by the same one-second cadence. The maintenance still runs once a second and never more often.
